title: AS2 compiler: postfix ++/-- returns new value instead of old (wrong semantics)
description: The compiler has a UnaryExpr handler but never checks expr.prefix (false=postfix, true=prefix). Postfix i++ should return the OLD value before incrementing, but the compiler always emits the prefix pattern (returns the new value). Fix: in the UnaryExpr handler for Increment/Decrement, check expr.prefix. For postfix: dup the variable before incrementing, so the old value is on the stack as the expression result.
